_minimumReleaseAgeWhy: pnpm on this machine enforces a minimumReleaseAge supply-chain policy and refuses a lockfile containing a package published inside the window. Without a matching setting here, Renovate opens PRs that cannot install -- vitest@5.0.1 was rejected exactly that way on 16 Sept 2026. Keep this at or above the pnpm policy window.

packageRules.description: D-16: Next.js tracks the Active LTS line and security releases land within 7 days. Majors are a decision, not a Renovate PR.

TypeScript is held on the 6.x line. typescript-eslint@8 peer-requires typescript <6.1.0, and typescript-eslint is what enforces VALIDATION.md §2's 'no any in a public interface' merge gate. Bumping TypeScript to 7 does not fail the build -- it silently disables a permanent gate. Revisit when typescript-eslint supports 7.
Group the lint toolchain so eslint and typescript-eslint never move apart.
Group the test toolchain: vitest and its coverage provider are version-locked to each other.
Pin every GitHub Action to a commit SHA. A mutable tag on a workflow with cloud credentials is a supply-chain hole.
